notes.title: Twisted Toys – Free Demo Arrives August 13!
notes.content:
Pack toys. Ship orders. Finish the shift… until the warehouse stops feeling empty.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687503/bfbb2393cbf123b2f17bc09d7919cc17c9051a30.gif"]



On August 13, you’ll get your first taste of Twisted Toys with our free demo. Step into the shoes of a night-shift worker in a seemingly quiet toy warehouse. What begins as a simple, repetitive job soon turns into a disturbing psychological horror experience.

In this 10–15 minute preview, you’ll explore the dimly lit aisles, learn the core mechanics of packing and shipping, and face your first chilling encounter with the unknown.

The toys have been waiting. Will you make it through the night?


📅 Demo Release Date: August 13, 2025
